<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-4 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:28px">Audition for <strong>2:22 A Ghost Story</strong> on 30th August</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large is-resized"><a href="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/2025/11/20/a-christmas-carol-december-2026/"><img data-attachment-id="13534" data-permalink="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/2-22-poster/" data-orig-file="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg" data-orig-size="3509,4959" data-comments-opened="0" data-image-meta="{"aperture":"0","credit":"","camera":"","caption":"","created_timestamp":"0","copyright":"","focal_length":"0","iso":"0","shutter_speed":"0","title":"","orientation":"0","alt":""}" data-image-title="2:22 A Ghost Story poster" data-image-description="" data-image-caption="" data-large-file="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=725" width="725" height="1024" src="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=725" alt="" class="wp-image-13534" style="aspect-ratio:0.7080140397302314;width:429px;height:auto" srcset="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=725 725w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=1450 1450w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=106 106w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=212 212w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=768 768w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2-22-poster.jpg?w=1440 1440w" sizes="(max-width: 725px) 100vw, 725px" /></a></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-5 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:16px">New parents Jenny and Sam invite friends Lauren and Ben round for dinner. Jenny is sure their house is haunted, and that something happens every night at 2:22 a.m. The four of them decide to stay up to find out. A real-time supernatural thriller which is smart and tense.</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-6 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:16px">Theatre 62 will stage one of the first amateur productions. It was produced in the West End from 2021 to  2024, and completed a UK tour last year.</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-7 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:16px">All the audition details <a href="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/auditions/">here</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-8 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:28px"><strong>Silver Lining</strong> opens 27th September. Tickets on sale</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large is-resized"><a href="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/2025/11/20/silver-lining-september-2026/"><img data-attachment-id="13247" data-permalink="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/silver-lining-poster/" data-orig-file="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg" data-orig-size="3374,4759" data-comments-opened="0" data-image-meta="{"aperture":"0","credit":"","camera":"","caption":"","created_timestamp":"0","copyright":"","focal_length":"0","iso":"0","shutter_speed":"0","title":"","orientation":"0"}" data-image-title="Silver Lining poster" data-image-description="" data-image-caption="" data-large-file="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=726" loading="lazy" width="726" height="1024" src="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=726" alt="" class="wp-image-13247" style="aspect-ratio:0.7089941362201173;width:430px;height:auto" srcset="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=726 726w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=1452 1452w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=106 106w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=213 213w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=768 768w, https://theatre62.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silver-lining-poster.jpg?w=1440 1440w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 726px) 100vw, 726px" /></a></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-9 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px"><strong>Box office open.</strong> This is a comedy which tells the tale of a group of five extraordinary-yet-forgotten women. They are residents in the Silver retirement home in Gravesend. They come together one treacherous stormy night to create The Great Escape – senior citizen style when a storm causes a flood in the home. But with no rescue team in sight, the ladies realise that in order to survive they must do what they have always done – do it themselves. Pure joy from one of Britain’s best-loved writers, Sandi Toksvig. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-10 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#deedf2;font-size:19px;line-height:1.1"><strong>About Us</strong></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-11 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#deedf2;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1">Theatre 62 is a busy amateur dramatic group. For over 60 years we have been producing a variety of shows – from dramas to comedies to thrillers. We produce several shows each year, running Monday to Friday evenings, with Saturday and Sunday matinees.</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-12 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#deedf2;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1">As well as the studio theatre we have a rehearsal room, a licensed bar, and extensive wardrobe, scenery, props, sound and lighting facilities. Find out more about what we do and how you can get involved <a href="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/get-involved/">here</a></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-13 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#deedf2;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1">The 119 bus stop is nearby. West Wickham train station is 15-20 minutes walk away. There is free parking available at the <a href="https://theatre62.wordpress.com/our-location/">Theatre</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-text-align-left has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#dcedef;font-size:19px;line-height:1.2"><strong>How to get involved</strong></p>

			<h1 class="entry-title">Book Tickets</h1>					</header><!-- .entry-header -->

		<div class="entry-content">
			
<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-1 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:16px"><strong>Evening performances normally start at 7.30 p.m. Matinees start at 3.00 p.m.</strong>  </p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-2 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#ecebeb;font-size:15px"><br>Tickets for shows go on sale one month before each production’s opening performance.</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-3 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#ecebeb;font-size:15px">Members ticket price: <strong>£10</strong></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-4 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#ecebeb;font-size:15px">Non-Members ticket price:<strong> £13</strong></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-5 wp-block-paragraph" style="background-color:#ecebeb;font-size:15px"><strong>Book tickets at</strong> <strong><a href="https://www.ticketsource.co.uk/theatre62" rel="nofollow">https://www.ticketsource.co.uk/theatre62</a></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-6 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px">Members and Non-Members can book online. There is no separate booking fee, which is included in the ticket price.</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-7 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px">Each online booking can be for any number of Non-Members and (optionally) one Member (i.e. only one Member ticket can be selected for each booking).</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-8 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px">If you are unable to book online, reservations can be made via:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-9" style="font-size:15px">email: boxoffice@theatre62.org.uk</li>
</ul>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-10" style="font-size:15px">phone: 07542 716 888</li>
</ul>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-11 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px">When booking by email or phone, online bank transfer is also possible. Details are available from the box office.</p>



<p class="has-dark-gray-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-12 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px">Please note <strong>the box office at the theatre is cashless</strong>, so payments on the door for reserved tickets should be made by card only.  Cash payments can be accepted, but only for the correct amount. Change cannot be given. Cheques made payable to  ‘Wickham Theatre Trust’ are also accepted.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:15px"></p>
